tools.name: track17_get_quota
tools.description: The account's tracking quota: total, used, remaining, used today, the daily registration limit (0 = no limit) and the free e-mail quota. Each registered tracking number uses 1 quota. POST /getquota.

tools.name: track17_list_tracking_numbers
tools.description: Search the tracking numbers registered on this account (40 per page) with their carrier, status, registration and last-update times, and latest event. Filter by number(s), carrier, tracking state, package status or registration date. Free: it does not use quota. POST /gettracklist.

tools.name: track17_get_tracking
tools.description: Full tracking details (status, sub-status, milestones, every carrier event with time and location, estimated delivery) for up to 10 numbers that are ALREADY registered on this account. Free: it does not use quota. A number that is not registered comes back in `rejected` — register it first with trac

tools.name: track17_realtime_lookup
tools.description: WRITE (uses quota): look up ONE tracking number directly at the carrier right now, without registering it. Costs 1 quota per call (standard: carrier data up to 3 hours old). If the number is already registered, a changed result is also pushed to the account. Not supported for USPS, Royal Mail, Austr

tools.name: track17_register_numbers
tools.description: WRITE (uses quota): start tracking up to 10 tracking numbers per call. Each ACCEPTED number costs 1 quota from this account (see track17_get_quota); rejected numbers cost nothing. Deleting and re-registering a number costs again. 17TRACK then updates the status itself every 6-12 hours; read it with

tools.name: track17_change_carrier
tools.description: WRITE: assign a different carrier to registered tracking numbers (up to 10 per call), for example when auto-detection picked the wrong one. A number can change carrier at most 5 times, and a successful change can be charged as one shipment (see track17_get_quota). POST /changecarrier.

tools.name: track17_change_tag
tools.description: WRITE: set the tag (your own label, max 100 characters) of a registered tracking number. It replaces the old tag. Free. POST /changeinfo.

tools.name: track17_stop_tracking
tools.description: WRITE: stop tracking registered numbers (up to 10 per call). The numbers stay in the account for 90 days with their history and can be restarted ONCE each with track17_retrack. Stopping does not refund quota. POST /stoptrack.

tools.name: track17_retrack
tools.description: WRITE: restart tracking of stopped numbers (up to 10 per call). Each number can be restarted only ONCE in its lifetime, so a second restart is rejected. POST /retrack.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: track17_get_quota, track17_list_tracking_numbers, track17_get_tracking, track17_register_numbers · Public sink: track17_get_quota, track17_list_tracking_numbers, track17_get_tracking, track17_realtime_lookup, track17_register_numbers, track17_change_carrier, track17_change_tag, track17_stop_tracking, track17_retrack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: track17_get_quota, track17_list_tracking_numbers, track17_get_tracking, track17_register_numbers · Public sink: track17_get_quota, track17_list_tracking_numbers, track17_get_tracking, track17_realtime_lookup, track17_register_numbers, track17_change_carrier, track17_change_tag, track17_stop_tracking, track17_retrack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
